subject: South Street Historic District Outreach
overview: The commission planned outreach efforts for the proposed South Street Historic District, including participation in the upcoming PorchFest event and the drafting of owner notification letters.

items.title: Remote Meeting Extension
items.summary: The chair noted that state law has extended the temporary provisions allowing for remote public meetings through March 31, 2025.

items.title: South Street Historic District Preliminary Report
items.summary: The commission reviewed a preliminary report drafted by Chris Skelly for the proposed South Street Historic District and discussed updating the commission's website with new guidelines.

items.title: PorchFest Outreach Planning
items.summary: The commission planned a public outreach presence at the June 3rd PorchFest, including a table at the iconic 'Grandfather’s House' to engage with neighbors and distribute information.

items.title: Owner Notification and Special Meeting
items.summary: Members agreed to draft a trifold brochure and a formal letter to notify the 18 property owners in the proposed district, scheduling a special meeting for May 18 to approve the final language.

items.title: Administrative Logistics and Mailing
items.summary: City staff will generate address labels for the 18 targeted properties while the commission manages the content of the outreach mailing.

items.title: Website FAQ and FAQ Softening
items.summary: The commission discussed updating the website’s FAQ to make it more user-friendly and to accurately reflect that current guidelines are more lenient than those in neighboring towns.

items.title: Historical Surveys and Refreshment Budget
items.summary: The commission discussed the status of missing Form B historical surveys and approved approximately $200 for pastries for the PorchFest outreach table.
